SQL:
SELECT
  customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
  COUNT(DISTINCT customers.id) AS "customers.customers_without_returns"
FROM customers AS customers
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM (
      SELECT
        customers.id AS id
    ) AS __slayer_spine
    LEFT JOIN returns AS returns
      ON __slayer_spine.id = returns.customer_id
    WHERE
      returns.id IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  customers.tier
ORDER BY
  "customers.tier" ASC
LIMIT 21
